steps.detail: Only the human account owner (or designated operator under owner authority) at the provider console.
Provider's official web console over HTTPS on a trusted device; never via SaathiOS LLM chat.
Verify TLS cert, official domain (e.g. app.alpaca.markets), and account identity before key creation.
Select only proposed read-only scopes: account_read, orders_read, activities_read (or provider-equivalent view-only).
Explicitly leave trading/order write permissions disabled. Abort if UI forces mixed scopes.
Ensure withdrawal/transfer permissions are off. Abort if not independently selectable.
Bind key to canary egress IP allow-list only.
Set shortest practical expiry (or calendar rotation if provider lacks expiry).
Use direct terminal secret prompt, OS keychain, or secret-manager operator workflow — never paste into LLM chat.
SaathiOS stores only a credential reference ID + metadata (provider, scopes claimed, expiry, IP policy). Raw secret stays in OS secret store.
Future controlled probe of allow-listed GET only after separate activation authority (NOT in M240–M247).
If provider supports key permission introspection, verify observed scopes match proposal exactly.
Any write/withdraw/transfer scope → immediate abort and revocation.
Create new key, enter via non-LLM path, switch ref, revoke old key at provider, verify old key fails.
Mark local ref SUSPENDED; stop collector; leave provider key intact until revoke decision.
Owner deletes/disables key at provider console; mark local ref REVOKED.
Confirm provider UI shows key deleted/disabled; optional fail probe returns auth error.
Delete secret from OS keychain/secret manager; retain only audit metadata and hashes.
Keep immutable audit of ceremony, rotation, revoke events.
Operator signs destruction checklist (human, not automation).

steps: Create new key with identical minimal scopes and IP allow-list
Enter new secret via non-LLM path
Owner deletes key in provider console
Remove secret from local secret store
No automated re-entry after security abort

destruction_checklist: Local secret material removed from keychain/secret manager
No secret present in logs, evidence, or chat transcripts
